# Third-party code

Copied unmodified from npm. Chrome Web Store doesn't allow loading code from the network, so the engines ship
with the extension; translation models are downloaded on first use.

| Directory | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `bergamot/` | [@browsermt/bergamot-translator](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@browsermt/bergamot-translator) 0.4.9 | [MPL-2.0](https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/), see `bergamot/LICENSE` |

Models: [Firefox Translations models](https://github.com/mozilla/firefox-translations-models), MPL-2.0,
downloaded from Mozilla's public model registry.
